AUDIT.NO_PAYS: Choose a country to show its log.
AUDIT.EMPTY: No change recorded for this country.

RUBRIQUES.HINT: The lines the payroll calculation puts on the payslip (base salary, contributions, tax…), in payslip order. Their values come from “Rates and scales”. The simulator uses “Payroll rules” instead.
RUBRIQUES.EMPTY: No active line item for this country in the engine.
RUBRIQUES.CODE_HINT: Suggested from the label (capitals, digits and _, 20 max). Cannot change once saved.
RUBRIQUES.CONTRACTS_HINT: No contract picked = the line applies to every contract.
RUBRIQUES.FORMULA_HINT: Advanced cases only. Available variables: STRATE_1 to STRATE_5 (total of each step), BRUT and the code of any line calculated earlier (e.g. CNSS_EE).
RUBRIQUES.ERR_CODE: Invalid code: upper case, digits and _ (20 max).
RUBRIQUES.ERR_DUPLICATE: Line item {{code}} already exists for this country.
RUBRIQUES.ERR_ASSIETTE: This calculation mode needs a base amount: without it, the line would be 0.
RUBRIQUES.ERR_TAUX: This calculation mode needs a parameter (rate, amount or target value).
RUBRIQUES.ERR_BAREME: This calculation mode needs a scale.
RUBRIQUES.ERR_FORMULA: This calculation mode needs a formula.

MODE_HINT.TAUX_PCT: Amount = base amount × rate ÷ 100, limited to the cap if there is one.
MODE_HINT.MONTANT_FIXE: The same amount every month, read from the chosen parameter.
MODE_HINT.BAREME_PROGRESSIF: The base amount is split into brackets, each with its own rate (like a tax).
MODE_HINT.ANNUALISE_BAREME: The base amount is turned into a yearly amount, the annual scale applied, then the result divided by 12.
MODE_HINT.FORMULE: The amount is the result of the formula.
MODE_HINT.NEWTON_RAPHSON: Finds the amount that gives the target value (e.g. gross from a net): SELF formula + target value parameter.

RUBRIQUES.CODE_LOCKED: The code does not change after creation.
RUBRIQUES.STRATE_HINT: Groups the payslip lines; each step has a total that later calculations can reuse.
RUBRIQUES.ORDER_HINT: Lower = higher on the payslip, and calculated first.
RUBRIQUES.ASSIETTE_HINT: The amount the rate or the scale applies to.
RUBRIQUES.KEY_HINT: Values come from “Engine parameters”. If the parameter you need does not exist, add it there first.
RUBRIQUES.PRORATA_HINT: Yes: the amount is reduced when the employee did not work the whole month.
RUBRIQUES.IMPACT_NOTE: Any change applies to the next payroll calculations — {{pays}}. Calculations already saved do not change.
RUBRIQUES.DEACTIVATE_NOTE: Once inactive, this line will no longer be calculated nor shown on the next payslips.

BENEFITS.HINT: Benefits in kind of a parameter set (meals, transport, housing…): editable while the set is a draft.
BENEFITS.NO_SET: No parameter set for this country.
BENEFITS.EMPTY: No benefit in this parameter set.
BENEFITS.READONLY_STATUS: “{{status}}” set: its benefits can only be edited while it is a draft. To change them, create a new set.
BENEFITS.READONLY_RIGHT: You are not allowed to edit parameter sets.
BENEFITS.ERR_DUPLICATE: Code {{code}} already exists in this set.

ENGINE_PARAMS.HINT: The rates, amounts and scales the payroll calculation uses, through the “Payslip items”. Only the active version is used. The simulator uses “Payroll rules” instead.
ENGINE_PARAMS.READONLY: Read-only version: only a draft can be edited. Create a new version to change values.
ENGINE_PARAMS.MISSING_KEYS: Missing parameters, used by active line items: {{keys}}. Submission will be refused.
ENGINE_PARAMS.KEY_HINT: Technical name in capitals (digits, _ and . allowed), then picked in “Payslip items”. Cannot change once created.
ENGINE_PARAMS.NUMBER_HINT: A rate is entered as a percentage: 9.18 for 9.18 %.
ENGINE_PARAMS.BAREME_HINT: One line per bracket: up to which amount, and at which rate. Each bracket starts where the previous one ends; the last one has no limit.
ENGINE_PARAMS.EMPTY: No version for this country. Create one with “New version”.
ENGINE_PARAMS.DRAFT_CREATED: Version {{version}} created as a draft, from the active version.
ENGINE_PARAMS.DELETE_USED: Parameter {{key}} is used by {{codes}}: without it the version cannot be submitted. Delete it anyway?
ENGINE_PARAMS.ERR_KEY: Invalid key: letters, digits, _ and . (50 max).
ENGINE_PARAMS.ERR_DUPLICATE: Parameter {{key}} already exists in this version.

ERR_VALUE.bareme: Incomplete scale: fill in every bracket (increasing limits, rate in %).

SUBMIT.TITLE: Submit version {{version}}
SUBMIT.BODY: The version will no longer be editable. It must be approved by HR then Finance before activation.

APPROVE_HR.TITLE: Approve version {{version}} (HR)
APPROVE_HR.BODY: The version then goes to Finance approval.

APPROVE_FINANCE.TITLE: Approve version {{version}} (Finance)
APPROVE_FINANCE.BODY: The version can then be activated.

ACTIVATE.TITLE: Activate version {{version}}
ACTIVATE.BODY: It will be used for every next payroll calculation of the country. The current active version will be archived.

ENGINE_PARAMS.UNUSED: No payslip item uses this parameter yet.
ENGINE_PARAMS.ERR_UPPER: Must be above the start of the bracket.

NEXT.SUBMIT: Next step: submit the version for approval.
NEXT.ACTIVATE: Next step: go live. The previous active version will be archived.

WAITING.SUBMIT: Waiting for someone allowed to submit.
WAITING.ACTIVATE: Waiting for Finance to activate it.

HELP.RULES: Creates the payroll rules of a country for a year (income tax scale, contributions) and has them approved by the Country Director and the CFO. Used by the simulator, candidate simulations and the employees’ net pay.
HELP.COUNTRIES: Countries handled by payroll, with their currency, fiscal year and activation.
HELP.ENGINE_PARAMS: Rates, amounts and scales of the actual payroll calculation (Payroll run, Results), by approved version.
HELP.RUBRIQUES: Payslip lines of the actual payroll calculation and how each one is calculated.
HELP.BENEFITS: Benefits granted to employees (meals, transport, housing) and their value.
HELP.ADVANCE_RULES: Eligibility conditions for salary advances, by country.
HELP.EMPLOYEE_CONFIG: Each employee's salary, contract, benefits and bonuses.
HELP.AUDIT: History of payroll changes, for internal control.
